name: How long does basement flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of basement flooring installation depends on the type of flooring, the basement's size, and the condition of the subfloor. For a typical 500-1000 square foot basement, installing luxury vinyl plank or tile can take 2-5 days. Engineered hardwood might take 3-7 days due to acclimatization requirements and more involved installation processes. This timeline includes subfloor preparation like cleaning and minor leveling. Extensive moisture mitigation or significant subfloor repairs will add extra time to the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on flooring type, size, and subfloor condition. Expect 2-7 days for a typical basement, plus extra for extensive prep.
